{{Quote|It so happens I might know where you might find that ship. Name's the ''First Light'', and you can find it on landing platform IIB8. Might want to hurry, though&hellip;|Fennix, to the freelance agents he met in Botcha's|<ref name="Outward Bound" />}}
'''Botcha's''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The establishment was often frequented by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] [[Fenix]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] searching for the stolen [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[First Light (freighter)|''First Light'']] ventured to Botcha's to seek to information on the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Landing platform IIB8|whereabouts]] from Fenix.

==Description==
Botcha's was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] situated in a [[Factory/Legends|factory]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]. The bar teemed with activity and at all [[Time/Legends|times]] of [[Standard day/Legends|day]] and was filled with a variety of working class beings of different backgrounds and professions. A layer of haze permeated throughout the bar, which was the result of a combination of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]], sweat and other substances. Outside the front of the bar was a worn, poorly-maintained [[Neon/Legends|neon]] sign displaying the name of the bar, but which was missing several [[Writing/Legends|letters]] and announced the establishment incorrectly as "Bo-c-s."<ref name="Outward Bound" />

Inside, Botcha's had tables for its patrons to sit at and a bar area from which alcoholic beverages could be purchased. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the bar was attended by a trio of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] whose [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] was so stained that the original [[Color/Legends|colors]] were difficult to determine. A raised walkway was included behind the bar, upon which the diminutive Ugnaughts stood to provide them sufficient reach to pass [[Foodstuff/Legends|drinks]] to the establishment's patrons. The Ugnaughts stared and and made derisory comments to any [[Gender/Legends|male]] patrons of the bar that they considered to be feminine in appearance. Drink prices at the bar ranged from two to ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Outward Bound" />

==History==
{{Quote|Thing's been quiet, late&mdash;too quiet. I think something big is going on, just under the surface. I can't put my finger on it, but mark me&mdash;there's something heatin' up.|Fenix, to the freelance agents he met in Botcha's|<ref name="Outward Bound" />}}
The bar was a favored haunt of the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] [[Fenix]].<ref name="Outward Bound" /> One [[Standard day/Legends|day]] in around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']] is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Fennix ventured to Botcha's to drink and he sat at a table at the back of the bar with two guests, a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] female and a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] male, where the Besalisk proceeded to become very inebriated. A group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] ventured to Botcha's in search of Fennix, seeking information regarding the whereabouts of the stolen [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[First Light (freighter)|First Light]]''. After the operatives bought him a drink, Fennix dismissed his two companions and invited the agents to sit with him. They bartered to agree a price for the Besalisk's information and the infochant then disclosed to the agents the [[Landing platform IIB8|location]] of the ''First Light'' and provided intelligence regarding recent developments on Druckenwell.<ref name="Outward Bound" />

==Behind the scenes==
Botcha's appeared within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']], a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Morrie Mullins]] and [[Lee Pickler]] that formed part of the [[Looking In trilogy|''Looking In'' trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. The adventure advises that the bar should be depicted during role-play as having an atmosphere similar to the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], a bar that featured in the film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Outward Bound" />
